svg.text: #5 lift at a crossing: former display (red dashed) vs physics (green). Vertical ×8. R = 38.2 mm, w = 0.714, Δ₁ = 0.27 mm, T = 1 N, k = 3 N/mm²

g.text: A. Single crossing at 90°: bump 0.6·w over ±w vs chord tent Δ₁ = 0.37 w over ±√(2RΔ₁) = ±4.5 mm; blue — dent of the lower thread (δ + (h − t_c)/2 ≈ 0.10 mm)
display: height ×1.6, length ×1/6 of physics; the tent is a straight chord in space, the ball surface falls away by x²/2R
landing on the soft wrap: free flight x₀ = 3.9 mm, tail e^{−x/λ_T}, λ_T = √(T/k) = 0.58 mm
B. Stack m = 2 (thread over two crossed threads): display 1.2·w → cap 1.0·w over ±w vs Δ(2) = Δ₁(1 + κ) = 0.48 mm over ±6.1 mm
κ = 0.8 (0.7–1.0): the lower thread carries the sum of the kink forces, the stack grows slightly slower than linear
C. Two crossings 6 mm apart (< 2a = 9 mm): display — two bumps (upper envelope), physics — one bridge (taut thread, a chord over both)
bridge midpoint: Δ₁ − L²/8R = 0.15 mm above the ball; a bridge, not a max: the profile is the convex hull of the apices over the sphere
